examples.en: Pick up some fresh fruit at local grocers instead.
examples.zh: 避免垃圾零食-你可以在当地的食品店里买一些新鲜的水果。

examples.en: Internet grocers are more popular in Britain, largely because many city-dwellers lack cars.
examples.zh: 在英国，由于很多城市居民没有汽车，网络杂货商要更加受欢迎。

examples.en: The following year came the Single Bottle Act, allowing grocers to sell wine by the bottle.
examples.zh: 随后的一年《单瓶酒法案》出台，允许零售商销售瓶装的葡萄酒。
